footnote_text: The acquisition of 62,928 shares of common stock ("Common Stock") of AngioDynamics, Inc. (the "Company") represents 62,928 restricted stock units, each of which represents a contingent right to receive one share of Common Stock. These restricted stock units vest in four equal annual installments consistent with awards granted to other executive officers of the Company and beginning on July 15, 2027, such that 25% of the restricted stock units will vest on each of July 15, 2027, 2028, 2029 and 2030, subject to the Reporting Person's continued employment through each applicable vesting date.

The acquisition of 38,265 shares of Common Stock represents 38,265 restricted stock units granted to replace equity compensation the Reporting Person forfeited at his prior employer, each of which represents a contingent right to receive one share of Common Stock. These restricted stock units vest in two equal annual installments, such that 50% of the restricted stock units will vest on each of November 2, 2027 and November 2, 2028, subject to the Reporting Person's continued employment through each vesting date.
